method: Actual packaged DICOMStudio UI controlled via native app automation, with screenshots where accessibility grouped text was stale.

checks.action: Entered temporary synthetic input with spaces/apostrophe/question mark, ImageType=ORIGINAL\PRIMARY; PatientName=DOE*; StudyDescription=M1 $HOME (literal), and a spaced output path; inspected quoted preview and clicked Run.
checks.observed: Console SUCCESS; all three literal values printed. Output byte-identical to fresh CLI output; independent explicit-VR decoding confirms tags and values.

checks.action: MWL form date -20261024, time -180000, patient DOE*, localhost port 1, verbose; clicked Run.
checks.observed: Preview uses --date=-20261024 and --time=-180000; runtime header preserves exact values. Expected no-peer connection timeout, not an interoperability pass.

checks.action: Changed MWL date to malformed single hyphen and clicked Run.
checks.observed: Shared validator reports Invalid date filter '-'; no successful query claimed.

checks.action: Selected Basic separately for actual dicom-wado query, retrieve, store and ups tabs.
checks.observed: All four show commented app-only/non-equivalent preview and no emitted Basic credentials.

checks.action: UPS Basic to Bearer, entered synthetic M1-TEST-TOKEN, then selected none.
checks.observed: Bearer restores command with --token M1-TEST-TOKEN; none removes --token. No HTTP request sent.

environment_observations: Initial direct Documents-path fixture read stalled in Foundation Data(contentsOf:) -> __open. App was closed; same synthetic bytes in /private/tmp executed successfully. Cause not conclusively determined; no privacy settings changed. Documents-path access is not qualified by this run.
Grouped accessibility labels sometimes remained stale while screenshots showed updated controls/previews. Rendered UI and execution console were inspected.
One transient noWindowsAvailable automation response was resolved by reconnecting to the same still-open app.
Application closed after checks. No existing clinical library files or saved server profiles were used or modified.
